arms.name: production_field
arms.what: the served placeholder on its own gated universe (depth gate applied, injury statuses as captured, beta from the 0.2% rule), scored on its own support; likelihood not comparable to the lifted-support arms

candidate_next_feature_if_the_residual_r.condition: prospective contests reproduce the retrospective residual: salary mean roughly right, salary tail roughly right, a consistent unexplained spike at exactly $0
candidate_next_feature_if_the_residual_r.test_if_fitted: held-out NLL and the rest of the salary distribution
candidate_next_feature_if_the_residual_r.warning: the three retrospective boards disagree on its sign (model share at $0: NE @ SEA 7.69% against 13.92%, DEN @ KC 4.68% against 6.67%, DET @ BUF 15.00% against 13.24%), so it is not fitted now

model: log w = beta * x - gamma * s; x = projected points (1.5x captain), s = salary left / 1000; gamma free in sign; nothing else
not_a_feature: realised duplication: it is the outcome the field model is asked to predict

primary.why: the target is cross-slate generalisation; a larger contest must not define the universal research parameter by its size

principal_criterion: per-entry NLL of projection+salary (frozen primary) minus projection-only (frozen baseline) on the representable support of a contest captured before lock; negative = salary helps

production.note: what a winning arm earns is preferred research family status for prospective validation, not production calibration; S5 stays deferred

provenance.model: frozen parameters copied from s7_salary.json; nothing fitted

recorded_hypothesis_not_built: the field is a mixture of user-level lineup-generation strategies rather than IID entries from one universal softmax (a model-family change, for after prospective validation)
rules: no refit of beta or gamma per slate
no new parameter after seeing a contest
score a contest before any of its counts changes anything
at least 3 genuinely pre-lock captured contests before another feature-selection round
the scorer refuses a capture stamped after the earliest contest start

secondary.why: sensitivity arm; the two poolings differ by under 0.05 in gamma

provenance.model: softmax(beta x - gamma s) over the lifted universe; theta by maximum likelihood (Newton)
